response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city AS city, COUNT(*) AS attendees FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code GROUP BY z.city), shares AS (SELECT city, attendees, attendees * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(attendees) FROM city_counts) AS share FROM city_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.attendees) AS avg_attendees, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - av.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.avg_share
